create_accelerometer_sensor: create an AccelerometerSensor instance with custom lower and upper bounds for robot base acceleration readings
configure_noise_generator: configure an AccelerometerSensor with a noise generator callable to add noise to delayed observations
set_sensor_latency: set sensor latency as a float or sequence of floats to control observation history length
get_observation: call get_observation on an AccelerometerSensor to retrieve the delayed 3D acceleration reading as a numpy array
review_accelerometer_sensor_class: review the AccelerometerSensor class and its gin configurable constructor for PyBullet Minitaur robot simulation
